web-development.title: Website Design & Development in Georgia | Webico
web-development.desc: Custom website design and development from a Tbilisi studio. Corporate sites, landing pages and web apps that load fast, rank well and bring enquiries.
web-development.lead: Company websites, landing pages and web apps built from scratch. Fast, clear on every screen and set up to bring in enquiries, not just to look good.
intro: Every project starts with one question: what should a visitor do on your site? Call, book, buy or send a request. The structure, the copy and the design all follow from that answer.
We design in Figma, build with clean code or WordPress depending on what fits, and hand over a site your team can update without calling a developer.
features: Multi-page sites that present your services, team and work, with a clear path to contact.
Focused pages for a single offer or campaign, built to convert paid traffic.
Portals, dashboards and booking systems with custom logic and user accounts.
English, Georgian, German or Russian versions on separate URLs with correct hreflang.
Optimised images, lean code and caching, so pages open fast on mobile networks.
GA4, Google Tag Manager and conversion events set up from day one.
web-development.for_text: A good fit if your current site does not bring enquiries, or if you are launching something new and want it done properly the first time.
for: Startups launching a product or service
Firms entering the Georgian or European market
Teams that need a site they can edit themselves
deliver: 30 days of free fixes after launch
process: Discovery
We learn about your business, customers and competitors, and agree on goals.
Design
Wireframes, then full designs in Figma. You approve before any code is written.
Build
Development, content, SEO basics and testing on real devices.
Launch
We go live, set up analytics and stay on hand to fix anything that comes up.
faq: How much does a website cost?
It depends on the number of pages, design depth, languages and integrations. After a first call you get a fixed quote within one or two business days.
How long does it take?
A typical company website takes three to eight weeks from kickoff to launch, depending on scope and how quickly content is ready.
Do you write the content?
We can. We write in English and Georgian with SEO in mind. If you already have copy, we edit and structure it.
Can we update the site ourselves?
Yes. You get an admin panel and a short training session, so texts, images and new pages are easy to manage.

wordpress-development.title: WordPress Development in Georgia | Webico
wordpress-development.desc: WordPress development in Tbilisi, Georgia: custom themes, Elementor, ACF, WooCommerce, integrations and multilingual sites. Fast, secure and easy to manage.
wordpress-development.h1: WordPress development you can manage yourself
wordpress-development.lead: Custom WordPress sites that load fast, rank well and let your team change texts and images without a developer.
intro: WordPress powers a large share of the web because it is flexible and easy to edit. It also gets slow and fragile when it is built with heavy themes and dozens of plugins.
We build lightweight custom themes from your approved design, use only the plugins you actually need, and set up the admin so it makes sense to non-technical people.
features: Built pixel-close to the Figma design, without heavy page builders.
Flexible content blocks your team can rearrange safely.
Online stores with payments, shipping rules and order management.
CRM, accounting, forms and email tools connected and syncing automatically.
WPML or Polylang with proper URLs and hreflang for every language.
Caching, image optimisation, hardening and regular updates.
wordpress-development.for_title: When WordPress is the right choice
wordpress-development.for_text: WordPress fits most marketing sites and small to mid-size stores. If your project needs something else, we will tell you on the first call.
for: Marketing sites with frequent content updates
Rebuilds of slow or broken WordPress sites
process: Audit or brief
For an existing site we audit theme, plugins, hosting and speed. For a new one we agree on structure.
Design
Prototype and layouts in Figma, approved before development.
Development
Custom theme, content blocks, integrations and testing.
Launch and care
Go-live, analytics, and updates and backups if you choose maintenance.
faq: WordPress or custom code: which is better?
WordPress is ideal when your team edits content often. Custom code makes sense for complex logic or very high traffic. We recommend based on your case.
Can you speed up our existing WordPress site?
Yes. We start with an audit of the theme, plugins, images, hosting and Core Web Vitals, then fix things step by step.
Who owns the site?
You do. Code, domain, hosting and admin access are all yours, and you can move them at any time.
Do you offer maintenance?
Yes: core, theme and plugin updates, security checks, daily backups and small content changes every month.

ecommerce-development.title: E-commerce Website Development in Georgia | Webico
ecommerce-development.desc: Online stores on WooCommerce, Shopify or custom code, built in Tbilisi. Card payments, shipping rules, product catalogues and a checkout people finish.
ecommerce-development.h1: Online stores that are easy to buy from
ecommerce-development.lead: WooCommerce, Shopify or custom builds with card payments, delivery rules and a checkout that works well on a phone.
intro: Many businesses start selling through Instagram or Facebook. As orders grow, so do the problems: orders get lost in messages, stock is tracked by hand and payment is a bank transfer.
A proper store fixes that. Customers choose, pay and receive confirmation on their own, and every order lands in one place.
features: Categories, filters by size, colour and price, search and product variants.
Card payments through local and international gateways, plus cash on delivery if needed.
Delivery zones and rates, courier integrations and order status updates.
Short checkout, guest purchase and a layout designed for mobile first.
Order management in the admin, stock tracking and email notifications.
GA4 e-commerce events and Meta Pixel, so you know which channel sells.
ecommerce-development.for_text: From a first store with a few dozen products to an established shop moving off a platform that no longer fits.
for: Brands selling through social media today
Businesses selling to tourists and abroad
process: Planning
Platform choice, catalogue structure, payment and delivery rules.
Design
Home, category, product and cart pages, designed for mobile first.
Development
Store build, payment gateway, integrations and product import.
Testing and launch
Test orders end to end, analytics, then go live.
faq: WooCommerce or Shopify?
WooCommerce gives full control and no monthly platform fee. Shopify is faster to start and very stable. We recommend based on your catalogue and team.
Which payment methods can you connect?
Card payments through Georgian banks and international gateways such as Stripe, depending on where you sell. Cash on delivery is also possible.
Will you upload our products?
We can upload the full catalogue, or set up the first products and templates so your team adds the rest.
How long does a store take?
Usually six to ten weeks, depending on the catalogue, integrations and how ready the product content is.

ui-ux-design.title: UI/UX Design & Branding Studio in Tbilisi | Webico
ui-ux-design.desc: UI/UX design, design systems, logos and brand guidelines from a studio in Tbilisi, Georgia. Interfaces and brands that stay consistent across every touchpoint.
ui-ux-design.lead: Interfaces, design systems, logos and brand guidelines that hold together from the first sketch to the last button.
intro: Good design is not decoration. It makes a product easier to understand and a brand easier to remember and trust.
We work in Figma, test flows with real scenarios and hand over files that developers can build from without guessing.
features: User journeys, information architecture and wireframes.
Websites, web apps and dashboards designed in Figma.
Clickable prototypes to test ideas before development.
Components, tokens and rules that keep products consistent.
Logo, colour, typography and visual language.
A clear guide for your team, printers and partners.
ui-ux-design.for_text: Startups shaping a product, companies refreshing an old brand, and teams that need a design system they can grow with.
for: Teams that need a design system
process: Research
Goals, audience, competitors and what already exists.
Concepts
Directions for the look and structure, discussed together.
Design
Detailed screens or brand elements, refined with your feedback.
Handoff
Organised files, guidelines and support during development.
faq: Do we need a full rebrand?
Not always. Often refining the existing visuals and writing clear rules is enough. A brand audit shows which option fits.
Do you design only, or build too?
Both. We can hand over designs to your developers or build the site or app ourselves.
How many concepts do we get?
Usually two or three directions at the start, then one is developed in detail.
Who owns the files?
You do. All source files and assets are handed over at the end of the project.
ui-ux-design.cta_title: Need a stronger brand or interface?

seo.title: SEO Services in Georgia | Technical SEO & Content | Webico
seo.desc: SEO services from Tbilisi, Georgia: technical audits, keyword research, on-page work, content and local SEO in English and Georgian, reported monthly.
seo.h1: SEO that brings the right visitors
seo.lead: Technical SEO, keyword research and content that help the people looking for your services find you on Google, without paying for every click.
intro: SEO starts with the basics: a site Google can crawl, fast pages and a clear structure. Then come the right keywords and content that actually answers what people search for.
We work in English and Georgian, report every month and explain results in plain language.
features: Crawling, indexing, speed, structured data and errors fixed in priority order.
What your customers search for, how often and how hard it is to rank.
Titles, headings, internal links and page structure.
New pages and articles written for people and search engines.
Google Business Profile, maps and local listings for every location.
Monthly report with rankings, traffic and what we did.
seo.for_text: Businesses that want steady enquiries from search instead of paying for every visit.
for: Sites that lost traffic after a redesign
process: Audit
Technical check, competitors and current rankings.
Strategy
Keyword map and a prioritised plan for the next months.
Work
Fixes, page optimisation and new content every month.
Reporting
Results, lessons and the plan for the next month.
faq: Can you guarantee first place on Google?
No. Nobody honest can, because nobody controls Google's algorithm. We can guarantee the work, transparency and steady improvement.
When will we see results?
Technical fixes usually show effect in one to two months. Stable growth takes three to six months of consistent work.
Do you do SEO in English and Georgian?
Yes, both, with separate keyword research for each language and market.
What does SEO cost?
Monthly SEO starts from 1,500 GEL. The exact price depends on the niche, competition and scope, and is fixed after the audit.

Monitoring, malware checks and fixes if something goes wrong.

Texts, images, banners and new pages within a monthly allowance.

website-maintenance.for_text: Any business whose website matters for sales or reputation and that has no developer in-house.
for: WordPress sites that need regular updates
Online stores where downtime costs money
process: Onboarding

Monthly routine
Updates, checks and backups on a schedule.
Requests
You send changes, we make them within the agreed time.
Report

Do you maintain sites you did not build?
Yes. We start with a short audit, fix anything critical and then take over regular care.
How fast do you respond?
Within one business day for requests, and the same day for anything critical.
What does it cost?
WordPress maintenance starts from 500 GEL per month and custom sites from 1,000 GEL, depending on the site.
website-maintenance.cta_title: Need someone to look after your site?

Pages built for a single campaign and offer.

We agree on goals and set up conversion tracking.

What if an ad channel does not work?
The first month is a test. If a channel does not perform, we change the approach or move the budget elsewhere.
